mainEntity.name: What is Song of Songs about?

acceptedAnswer.text: A collection of love poems between a bride and her beloved, read by Jews and Christians also as a picture of the love between God and his people.
Titled "of Solomon"; scholars differ on whether he wrote it.

mainEntity.name: When was Song of Songs written?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditionally the 10th century BC; others date it later.

mainEntity.name: What are the main themes of Song of Songs?
alternateName: what does Song of Songs teach

acceptedAnswer.text: Main themes: love, desire, faithfulness, beauty.

mainEntity.name: What are key passages in Song of Songs?
alternateName: famous verses in Song of Songs

acceptedAnswer.text: Among the best known: Song of Songs 2:4; Song of Songs 8:6–7.
